# fjordrun_domain (Resource)

A domain of a service in one environment: generated (a `*.fjordrun.app` hostname, when `hostname` is left out) or custom (Hobby plan or higher).

A custom domain needs the records in `dns_records`, then verification. The TXT value only exists once the domain is created, so:

- If Terraform manages the DNS zone, create the records from `dns_records` and add a `fjordrun_domain_verification`, which waits until the domain is active.
- If someone adds the records by hand, `wait_for_verification = true` makes this resource wait for them. If the time runs out the apply succeeds with a warning and `status` stays `pending_dns`, because recreating the domain would change the TXT value.

The API can't change a domain, so `hostname` and `target_port` replace it. Replacing a custom domain issues a new TXT value to publish.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "fjordrun_project" "shop" {
  team_id = var.team_id
  name    = "shop"
}

resource "fjordrun_service" "web" {
  project_id     = fjordrun_project.shop.id
  environment_id = fjordrun_project.shop.default_environment_id
  name           = "web"
  source         = { type = "image", image = "nginxdemos/hello:0.4" }
}

# A generated *.fjordrun.app hostname.
resource "fjordrun_domain" "generated" {
  service_id     = fjordrun_service.web.id
  environment_id = fjordrun_service.web.environment_id
}

# A custom hostname.
resource "fjordrun_domain" "shop" {
  service_id     = fjordrun_service.web.id
  environment_id = fjordrun_service.web.environment_id
  hostname       = "shop.example.com"
}

# The records to publish, for example with a DNS provider's resources: for_each over this.
output "dns_records" {
  value = fjordrun_domain.shop.dns_records
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID.
- `service_id` (String) Service ID.

### Optional

- `hostname` (String) Custom hostname, in lower case. Leave out for a generated domain.
- `target_port` (Number) Port of the service to route to (1-65535). Defaults to the service's port, or 8080.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `wait_for_verification` (Boolean) For a custom domain: keep checking the DNS records until the domain is active, up to the `create` timeout (default 30 minutes).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `dns_records` (Attributes List) The DNS records a custom domain needs: a CNAME to the edge and a TXT record proving ownership. Empty for generated domains. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_records))
- `id` (String) Domain ID.
- `kind` (String) `generated` or `custom`.
- `status` (String) `pending_dns` (publish the records, then verify), `provisioning_tls` or `active`.
- `url` (String) The domain's URL.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--dns_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dns_records`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Record name.
- `type` (String) Record type.
- `value` (String) Record value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# service_id/environment_id/domain_id
terraform import fjordrun_domain.shop 77777777-7777-7777-7777-777777777777/66666666-6666-6666-6666-666666666666/99999999-9999-9999-9999-999999999999
```
